closes: A repeatable no-provider journey now joins PAYG checkout admission, Firestore capacity, exact GBP 7.00 catalogue use, paid fulfilment, guest booking, confirmation composition/state, signed cancellation and refund convergence.

The exact waiver and PAYG terms versions and original server acceptance timestamp are asserted unchanged across the intent, order, durable guest-booking evidence, confirmation outbox and rendered customer email; the outbox also binds each immutable document URL and SHA-256 digest.
The Privacy Notice version shown at checkout is bound through the same records and rendered as shown, not accepted or consented to.
The confirmation worker is executable in tests without sending real email because the sender is injected and RESEND_API_KEY is deliberately blank.
Duplicate-attendee and full-class attempts leave the relevant class counters and provider Checkout count unchanged.
limitations: This does not run a real Stripe test-mode Checkout, test card payment, signed webhook delivery, provider refund, dispute or Dashboard readback and therefore must not mark the full Stripe-test operational gate verified.
Firebase Functions emulator mode disables production App Check enforcement; a deployed browser-to-callable App Check journey remains separate evidence.
The injected email sender proves application composition and convergence only; it does not prove Resend acceptance, inbox delivery or the PAYG paid/refund/dispute email drill.
The business-owned PAYG paid, refund, dispute, late-cancellation and no-show operational drills remain pending until recorded by the staffed operators.
This test does not deploy code, reconcile the existing live Stripe delivery backlog, open purchase, or exercise production alert delivery.
